title: The Princess De Montpensier
author: Madame de (Marie-Madeleine Pioche de La Vergne) La Fayette
description: "The Princess De Montpensier" by Madame de La Fayette is a short novel published in 1662.
longDescription: Set during France's Wars of Religion, it tells the story of a young noblewoman married without love and caught between duty and desire.

authorInfo.bio: Madame de (Marie-Madeleine Pioche de La Vergne) La Fayette (1634–1693) is the author of The Princess of Cleves. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
